pictures.author: الدبوني
pictures.observed: Rebuilt pale coursed stone courtyard arcade: repeated pointed arches, thick plain piers, deep shaded corridor and small rear rectangular windows. At the northwest end stands a very tall warm-brick cylindrical minaret above a square patterned base, with horizontal relief bands and projecting upper balcony. Original brick geometry/tints suggest bands, not copied decorative motifs. Temporary lights/signs/plants are omitted.
